$comment: Itération numérique corrective bornée aux quatre cas coarse; les conditions physiques F49 restent inchangées.

numerical_controls.advection: bounded first-order upwind for U, h, K, k and omega

initialization.pressure_pa_abs: arithmetic mean of source total pressure and sink static pressure
initialization.rationale: quiescent pressure-driven start with no reversed initial kinetic energy; thermal wall step is retained rather than softened

energy_balance.port_flux_sign: OpenFOAM phi is outward-positive: source inflow is negative and sink outflow is positive
energy_balance.unsteady_storage_w: finite difference of volume integral rho*(h + 0.5*mag(U)^2)
energy_balance.wall_flux_interpretation: reported wallHeatFlux sign is retained explicitly; no sign is flipped to force closure
energy_balance.gate_rule: closure may pass only with measured transient storage and without a solver or temperature-guard failure
